issues.description: table() crashes with TypeError when rows is empty, breaking empty usage, failure, and top reports.
run_ingest() commits valid records before rejecting malformed-row thresholds, so a failed ingest still mutates the database.
Failure reporting misses real Slurm OUT_OF_MEMORY states despite the README promising out-of-memory jobs.
parse_elapsed() rejects valid sacct elapsed forms such as MM:SS even though Slurm documents [DD-[HH:]]MM:SS.
Rows with extra pipe-delimited columns are silently accepted because csv.DictReader extras are never checked.
Timezone-aware timestamps are accepted but not normalized, leading to incorrect string-based time filtering downstream.
Date filtering compares timestamp TEXT lexicographically, which is fragile for mixed date, datetime, or timezone formats.
parse_alloc_tres() allows negative GPU counts, which can produce negative GPU-hour totals.
File and SQLite operational errors are not handled, so common CLI failures can surface as raw tracebacks.
CLI tests miss critical negative paths: empty reports, failed-ingest rollback, OUT_OF_MEMORY, and invalid-but-accepted CSV shape.
Project has no linting, formatting, typing, or security-check tooling configured for cleanup-era maintainability.
